steps.content: [DeadLover Radio Page]

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Oh my, did you hear, Lil Daisy?! My drama radar's going absolutely haywire! Former super-idol Phanuel is doing a livestream from inside the Bureau!

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: I've heard something along those lines. So? Did she like, cave under the pressure? Or is she still trying to milk her fans even now?

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: The whole internet's watching! Is she a real victim or just playing innocent? Will this be a comeback or a total trainwreck? Ooh, this drama's enough to entertain me for a whole year!

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: You're getting ahead of yourself. You really think the Bureau's just gonna let you watch for free? It's either a PR stunt or a trap. Watch, the feed's gonna cut halfway through, and you'll get some crap saying they're experiencing technical difficulties.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Hey, I'll never say no to free drama! If they're bold enough to stream it, I'm gonna watch! If anything, I'm starting a column to react to the whole thing! Hmm, for the title, let's do: "Former Idol's Reputation Rehab Stream? A Drama Connoisseur's Field Notes"!

steps.speaker: Lil Daisy
steps.content: Go right ahead. I'll be there to scrape up what's left of you when the mob comes for you. And I'll sell that busted computer of yours to cover the legal fees.

steps.speaker: Love
steps.content: Everyone, stay tuned to our channel! Don't go anywhere—
[Scene Change] Bureau
"Phanuel's 24 Hours: Innocent Victim or Demonic Idol Who Had It Coming?"
[Livestream Camera]
At seven in the morning, a staff member pushes open the door to the supervision room.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Phanuel, it's time to get up.
Phanuel has been awake for a while, but she simply lies in bed, not moving a bit. Her eyes are fixed on the ceiling.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Phanuel?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Getting up... is that an order?

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: ...An order?
(Flashback)

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If she doesn't move, give her an "order."
[End of Flashback]

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: That's right. It's an order.
She doesn't budge, but her stomach growls and gives her away. The staff member, at a loss, props the camera off to the side.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Aren't you hungry? Breakfast is already over, so you'll have to wait for lunch. Wait, you haven't changed or washed up yet, either?
[Black Screen]
The staff member quickly covers the camera. In the darkness, all that can be heard is a gentle voice, along with the soft rustle of fabric.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: How do I... put this outfit on?

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Isn't this your outfit? How did you used to put it on?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Someone would dress me... I think?

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: No, you got the front and back reversed... and you've done the snaps wrong too. Why is this outfit so complicated...?
[Black Screen, Left-Aligned Text]

[Bullet Comments]
She can't even dress herself? This has to be fake.
She did rely on assistants and stylists before. Plus, wouldn't be surprising if a performance outfit like this is complicated.
This is way too over the top, she's definitely acting
I heard she got amnesia, but... Can you really forget something this basic? That's terrifying
[Scene Change: Command Room]

In the command room, the darkened screen reflects your furrowed, troubled face. You watch the comments drift by in silence, still not sure whether the livestream was a stroke of genius or a terrible mistake.

steps.speaker: Nino
steps.content: Oh wow, tens of thousands of people are watching already! And everyone's just been quietly watching this girl this whole time? I wish my stream could get numbers like this!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: See? I told you the livestream's gonna be a great idea, Chief! How about we let some of the others make an appearance too? We could do a little promotion while we're at it, bring in some revenue for the Bureau!
You deliver a swift karate chop to the top of EMP's head.
Livestreaming Phanuel's daily life at the Bureau was a bold call as is. On top of that, you've made sure to keep the other Sinners out of frame, limiting the camera to Phanuel alone.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Ow! Chief, how could you?! This is betrayal! You literally said my idea was the only sensible suggestion in the room yesterday!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Give me a break. I'm honestly starting to regret this ridiculous idea...

Whatever. The livestream was, after all, the least outrageous suggestion this bunch of geniuses had come up with. Playing dead was never an option. Let's just hope that sincerity is enough for this boss fight against the public rage.
(Scene change)
Not long after, the camera feed returns to normal.

In front of the full-length mirror, Phanuel's outfit is almost complete, save for a few accessories that haven't quite been fastened. She looks down at the misaligned decorative chain and the undone bow, and clumsily works them apart, then lines them back up.

She tries her best to learn how to put on her own intricate stage outfit, and it takes her a full twenty minutes until she gets it right. When she finally does, she looks up at the camera with a small smile.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: All done. Pretty impressive, right?
The angelic smile is super effective. So much so that the staff has this blissful smile as he gets back to fixing Phanuel's hair.
[Bullet Comments]

OMG it's her signature Angel smile!
Am I the only one who thinks her smile looks fake?
Is she looking at the camera? This is a livestream, not a variety show.
You guys never learn, do you? Already falling for her tricks again?
[End black screen]
[Scene Change] Cafeteria
The Bureau's food isn't half bad. There's rice, soup, a side dish, and a whole fish.
But Phanuel doesn't move a muscle. She simply stares down at her tray, then at the staff member. The staff, clearly experienced by now, speaks up in a commanding tone.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Phanuel, eat.
Phanuel obediently picks up her fork and spears a piece of fish, which promptly falls apart. She tries again to bring a piece to her mouth, but puts it back down in the end.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: What's wrong? Is the food not to your taste?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: No... the fish has bones.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Someone would pick out the bones for me before... but I can't remember who it was anymore.
She sets her fork down.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: What am I supposed to do when there's no one to tell me what to do? Why did the person who arranged everything for me disappear...
And so she sits at the table, smiling quietly, lonely and beautiful.
Dissenting voices begin to appear in the comments:

[Bullet Comments]
I can't watch this anymore. I feel for her, she's so pitiful.
Hold on, doesn't anyone else find this scary? She needs someone to tell her how to eat?
Scary? She's a victim. Look at her, she can barely take care of herself. What else can she do besides being kept at the Bureau?
She really is just a tool, isn't she? Is her manager the one who "arranged everything"? She can't even eat on her own, now that they're gone. Just what did that agency think she was?
[Scene Change] Surveillance Room
You stand before the surveillance console, arms crossed, saying not a word.
On screen, Phanuel is clumsily pouring water in front of the camera. It spills across the table, and she scrambles to wipe it up before looking at the camera with an embarrassed little smile.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, it seems that public criticism toward the Bureau and Phanuel has died down somewhat now, thanks to the livestream. That said, the majority of those watching are still haters, or people who've come for the drama.
You nod, gesturing for Nightingale to proceed as planned.
[Scene Change] Hypnotherapy Room
Phanuel sits in a red velvet chair, fingers laced together on her knees. The counselor sits across from her, wipes the small table between them, and lights a stick of incense on it.

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: Please relax, Phanuel. We're not here to talk about the case or your memories today. Let's just have a casual chat about how you're feeling, alright?
Phanuel smiles, visibly more at ease than before. Her movements are gentle, almost meek.

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: What's the first thing you feel when you wake up in the morning?
Phanuel lowers her head, pauses to think, then looks back up after what seems like a deliberate beat.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: ...Cold.

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: Cold?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Mhm. The sheets are cold, the blanket is thin, and the room is cold too. I don't remember what my bed used to be like, but I feel like... it must have been warm, and soft, and big...

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Oh, I didn't mean that as a criticism toward the Bureau...

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: Do you remember what you used to do before bed?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: No. All I know is there were a lot of people around. There was someone to take care of my daily needs, someone to remove my makeup and get me warm milk, and someone who was very strict, pushing me to practice every day.

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: Sounds like there was quite a team looking after you.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Mhm, there were lots of people. But... I can't remember any of them. Not their names, their faces, or their voices...

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: Phanuel, does this sound familiar to you—your mind doesn't remember something, but your body knows how to do it perfectly?
Phanuel's eyes light up ever so slightly, as if the counselor had just put her exact thoughts into words.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Yes! There was this one time Wynn showed me a fan support video on her phone. I saw this gesture where everyone raises their hand, makes a heart shape, then flips it outward. And my hand just... moved on its own!

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: Do you know what that gesture means?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I don't know... That's why it made me so sad. I don't remember what that gesture means, even though my hands still do.
Her eyes redden, slowly and in layers. First, it is the corners, then it spreads across the whole rim. Her eyes are filled with tears, but she holds them back, not letting a single one fall.
Moved by this sight, the counselor reaches out and gently pats the back of her hand.

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: It's okay. Take your time.
Phanuel looks down and composes herself. Her gaze drifts to the watch on the counselor's wrist, its surface catching a reflection of her own forlorn expression.

Immediately after, she braces herself against the back of the chair and rises slowly, as though too weak to stand unassisted. Yet she's managed to position herself so that the light catches the side of her face, illuminating her pale cheek and casting her slender shadow long across the floor.
Right now, she appears fragile and helpless, like a bird forced into the spotlight for others to watch.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Actually... there's something that's been weighing on me. Would it be alright if I talked to you about it?

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: Of course. Take your time and say whatever comes to mind.
Phanuel lowers her gaze and asks softly, as though it's taking every last bit of her courage.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: Is there... still anyone out there who supports me?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: My <color=#FFC9F3>Cherubs</color>... are they okay? Did I disappoint everyone? Is anyone receiving hate for ever liking me?
She looks up. The camera catches it all: the faint trembling of her lashes, the redness at the corners of her eyes, the expression of someone fighting back tears.

[Danmaku]
Her first instinct was to worry about her fans... Damn...
Wait, didn't she lose her memories?
Give me a break. Isn't there still that video of her throwing away fan gifts?
A little late to be playing the victim.
The case isn't settled yet, right? She seems pretty lost too. Let's just wait and see.

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: You know about the Cherubs? Do you... remember something?

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: No... I only heard the name <color=#FFC9F3>Cherubs</color> from someone else...
Phanuel's face is full of remorse. She pauses, perhaps to carefully sort through the feeling lodged in her chest.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: But when I heard that name... it felt like something important had come back to me. Something warm. Like someone calling my name softly from far away...
Phanuel looks to the counselor, her tone almost pleading.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: There are some things I want to tell everyone. But I'm afraid I won't say them right... Could you help me practice?
The counselor notices her sudden surge of emotion and nods, taking it as a breakthrough.

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: Of course. Just imagine I'm them.

Phanuel smiles gratefully. But in the next instant, her gaze drifts past the counselor's shoulder. She tilts her head ever so slightly, angling her left side toward the camera. Her best angle. Her most innocent one.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: It's been a long time, my dear Cherubs.
Her voice is soft. Everyone watches in silence, waiting for her next words. Not a single comment flies across the screen—you'd think the chat has been locked.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I know many of you are probably very disappointed and angry right now, wondering if you liked the wrong person.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: If that's the case, I'm sorry.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I can't remember if I lost the gifts you gave me, if I ever let you down, or if the people I hurt are still suffering.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: But if any of it is true, I won't run from what I've done. Because the people I hurt shouldn't lose their right to grieve just because I've lost my memories.

[Danmaku]
She's still trying to reassure her fans... maybe I was being too harsh.
...She actually responded? She didn't deny anything, didn't deflect either.
That line got to me, ngl.
She must really be scared of her fans turning on her. It'd be awful if she ended up like that washed-up idol who got torn apart by everyone.
Honestly, she's handling this better than a lot of people would.
Wake up, people! Don't let this woman fool you! Did you all forget she threw gifts out like trash? You've gotta be missing a brain if you genuinely stan her!
(Scene change)
You watch as the screen becomes flooded with comments once again, and find yourself becoming intrigued.
She doesn't need to point fingers at anyone. All she has to do is lower herself enough, and others will do the rest.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Should we pause, Chief?
You click on the screen and scrub back to the moment the counselor was comforting Phanuel. A brief flash of red light catches your eye. You pause, then rewind to look again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Keep going. Let her finish.
(Scene change)

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: So please, don't blame the Bureau because of me. And don't blame the people trying to uncover the truth. They only want to know what happened. And I do too.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I'll cooperate with the Bureau and accept their investigation. If I really did something wrong, I'll apologize, make amends, and face the consequences, whatever they might be.

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: Phanuel, the case hasn't been settled yet. No one is asking you to take responsibility for everything right now.
Phanuel looks at the counselor and gently shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: But someone has to step up and say sorry.
Her nails dig into her palm. The flash of pain crosses her face before she can hide it, and the counselor catches it.

steps.speaker: Counselor
steps.content: Your hand—

Phanuel tries to hide her hand behind her back, but the counselor grabs her wrist. Her slender, pale hand is turned open, revealing a web of scratches ranging from shallow to deep. Her nails are ragged too, bitten down to the quick from anxiety.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: It's fine... It's all my fault. I don't want anyone else getting blamed because of me.

[Danmaku]
She's handling this so well. She must be terrified and anxious herself...
She's not playing the victim or pointing fingers. She's speaking up for everyone.
The people who say she acts like a diva and is cold-blooded really need to see this.
She doesn't even remember anything and she's still apologizing... This isn't the drama I signed up for...
I'm starting to think people lied to get her "exposed"...
The doubt hasn't been washed away completely, but the chat is starting to be swayed. And that, is exactly how tides begin to turn.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: I just want to remember. I want to know what I did wrong, I want to know how to make things right, and I want to know... whether I deserve to stand on that stage again.
She quietly takes a breath, swallowing the urge to cry.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: If there's anything I do remember... It's that I really, really want to be on stage. I want to bring everyone happiness and make you smile.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: So, please. Don't fight on my behalf, and don't hate anyone for my sake.
She pauses, then finally looks up. Her eyes are glistening, full of tears, as if she were looking through the camera lens, her gaze reaching every single person watching the stream.

steps.speaker: Phanuel
steps.content: But... please don't forget me either.
The stream falls silent for a moment. Then the chat erupts.

[Danmaku]
We remember you! The Cherubs will always remember you!
Don't be scared. We'll always be waiting.
"Don't forget me"... Even I feel sad now. She really deserves better.
Never was a fan of hers, but now I get why she was popular.
I can't forgive you for what happened before, but I'm willing to wait for the truth.
OMG I'm in love. She's an Angel!
I forgive her. Like actually.
Justice for Phanuel!!!
I'll protect this smile!! Starting today, I'm a Cherub!!
She just wants to be remembered. Am I the only one who feels so sorry for her?
I was too scared to speak up before, afraid of getting attacked. But I always believed she'd never do that to us.
You raise your hand. The stream ends.
Crackle. The feed cuts. Amidst the noise on the screen, Phanuel still holds that same expression, so fragile it might crumble at a moment's notice.
And just as the counselor looks down to find the bandages, the tears vanish from Phanuel's face. She glances down at the marks on her palm, and a faint smile crosses her lips.
But fleeting as that smile may be, it doesn't escape your notice.
